biography: Paulo Evangelista's journey began on the sun-baked karting tracks of São Paulo. His father, a mechanic with a passion for Formula One, recognized Paulo’s innate talent early, spending countless hours tuning his son’s kart. Paulo's aggressive overtaking maneuvers quickly earned him local notoriety. His breakthrough came at the Brazilian Karting Championship, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical failure, he carved his way through the field to win in a breathtaking display of skill. Transitioning to Ginetta racing in his early twenties, Paulo faced financial hurdles, often relying on the generosity of local businesses to keep his racing dreams alive. A defining moment was the 2018 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup season finale at Brands Hatch, where a daring last-lap move secured him the championship. Now, at 32, Paulo is a seasoned competitor, known for his calculated approach and unwavering focus, aiming to make a significant mark in the world of GT racing.
drivingStyle: Paulo Evangelista is a calculating driver who prioritizes consistency and tire management. He doesn't often make flashy overtakes, preferring to patiently set up his moves, exploiting the smallest of weaknesses in his opponents' defenses. His corner entry is precise, focusing on maintaining momentum through the apex and maximizing exit speed. He's exceptionally good at reading track conditions and adapting his driving to preserve his tires, allowing him to push hard in the later stages of a race when others are struggling. Under pressure, Paulo remains remarkably calm, a trait that has earned him numerous podium finishes in tense, last-lap situations.

careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup championship at Brands Hatch with a daring last-lap overtake, proving his talent and securing vital sponsorship for his career.
